_useCaseDescriptions._note: Reference for what each value in a template's `useCases` array represents. Templates may carry multiple use cases; pick the tag(s) that reflect what the template actually IS, not what it could become.
_useCaseDescriptions.STARTER: Entry-level scaffold for a user's first Actor — language quickstarts, empty projects, standby starters, generic wrappers (e.g. cli-start).
_useCaseDescriptions.WEB_SCRAPING: Extracting structured data from websites — HTTP scrapers, browser scrapers, crawlers. The template's primary output is scraped data.
_useCaseDescriptions.INTEGRATION: Bridges Apify with external systems — Standby mode (serves HTTP), MCP servers (callable by AI clients), or templates that call out to external APIs, services, or CLIs.
_useCaseDescriptions.AUTOMATION: Performs actions rather than extracting data — test runners, browser automation (Playwright/Selenium/Cypress used for interaction), CLI orchestration.
_useCaseDescriptions.AI: LLM-powered agents, AI tool servers (MCP), and AI framework integration demos (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.).
